_note: Engine config — Prototype Build Spec v2 (D/Prototype_Build_Spec_v2.md). Every threshold the engine uses lives HERE, never inline in code: A1 labels, A2 sub-weights, A5 risk tiers. Change a number, re-run `python harness.py` — the sensitivity sweep reports the quadrant churn. JSON (not YAML) so the engine adds no dependency.

labels._precedence_note: hidden_winners is evaluated FIRST and wins where conditions overlap (A1).

hidden_winners.rule: disagreement >= theta AND composite_confidence >= 0.5 AND signal_count >= 10
hidden_winners.tooltip: Our evidence is materially more positive than the incumbent rating, on enough signals to mean it.

future_leaders.tooltip: Already rated above the median and still improving on live evidence.

overrated_leaders.tooltip: Rated above the median while the live evidence deteriorates — the stable-score blind spot.

value_traps.tooltip: Rated below the median and still deteriorating.

consensus.tooltip: Our read and the incumbent rating agree — nothing to disagree about.

component_weights._note: Composite momentum = weighted mean of the four component momenta. Disclosed, swept by the harness.

digital_subweights._note: A2 — sums to 1.00. digital_risk carries direction -1 by default (a breach is a negative).

source_quality._note: Confidence multiplier by source type. Company PR is CAPPED at 0.5 — the Adaro lesson (D/Backtest_Candidates_for_Rai.md case 4).

momentum_shrinkage._note: Composite momentum is a DIRECTION consensus in [-1,+1], so one weak one-sided signal would otherwise score the same +1.000 as twelve corroborating ones. Shrinkage multiplies it by w/(w + half_credit_weight), where w is the company's total evidence weight (sum of materiality x confidence x decay). At w = half_credit_weight the company keeps half its raw score. An extreme score now has to be earned by evidence that is both one-sided AND substantial.

_shrinkage_tuning: 0.4 chosen against the data, not by feel: a well-covered company carries ~1.2 units of evidence weight and keeps ~75% of its consensus, while REE's single dated signal (w=0.07) keeps 15% — it scored a fully-confident +1.000 before. Sweep it with `python harness.py --sweep`.
_forward_looking_note: Announcement/target language ('targets', 'plans to', 'by 2030') has its materiality halved — the engine scores what happened, not what was promised (Adaro case).

decay._note: Exponential time decay on signal weight. 180d = the spec's Long horizon; the Short horizon (45d) is a config swap only, per INSTRUCTIONS step 8 (build only if asked).

confidence._note: confidence = coverage x [mean_quality + (1 - mean_quality) x corroboration_weight x corroboration]. Coverage = how MUCH evidence (full credit at saturation_count signals); mean_quality = how GOOD it is (source_quality above); corroboration = how BROAD it is (distinct component/subcomponent routes, full credit at breadth_saturation). Corroboration is what lets independent lines of evidence lift confidence above any single source's ceiling — one source can only ever be as good as itself.

risk_tiers._note: A5 — derived at runtime from the score record + the company metadata CSV. Non-matching companies DIM, never hide.

pipeline_counts._note: A6/B2 — the three on-screen origination counts. Definitions live here so the money slide and the UI can never disagree about what N, M and K mean.

M.label: pipeline
M.rule: matches the Balanced tier — our disagreement is material, the company is investable, and no reviewed label has priced it yet

K.label: review list
K.rule: disagreement >= theta but not in N or M — we disagree, something (confidence, profitability, unverified metadata) still blocks it. A human looks at these.

green_bond_tiers._note: A4 — four tiers, best first. PROVISIONAL is a treatment applied ON TOP of any tier (is_provisional=TRUE in the metadata CSV), not a fifth tier.
